title: Release notes — structured source
description: Per-release source of truth at release-notes/v<X>.<Y>.<Z>.json. The generator validates every field against this schema PLUS a leak-vocabulary sweep before emitting markdown (single-line CHANGELOG.md entry OR multi-section release-page markdown).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file. Lets editors validate the JSON inline.

version.description: Strict semver (digits + dots, no `v` prefix). Matches the file's basename (vX.Y.Z.json).

headline.description: Single-line summary. No trailing punctuation. Starts with capital letter or backtick. Operator-facing — leak-vocabulary sweep rejects phase / sweep / tier / batch / group / slice numbering and AI-tooling names.

summary.description: Optional. 1-3 sentences expanding the headline. Ends with sentence punctuation.

title.description: Short item title. No trailing punctuation. Starts with letter or backtick.

body.description: Explanatory prose for the item. Ends with sentence punctuation.
